notes.title: BUG repair update and new instructions
notes.content:
1. Modified the bug where the treasure interface potion was lost without reason.

2. Added instructions for restoring HP health and treating diseases in the camp.

3. Added instructions for creating a weapon interface.

4. Added content in the interface description of refining reagents to make it more detailed and understandable.
